highlights.title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red
highlights.summary: Claude‑Red is a GitHub library of structured offensive‑security skill files for the Claude AI system.
highlights.detail: Each SKILL.md file encodes expert methodology for attacks such as SQL injection, shellcode development, and EDR evasion, enabling automated security reasoning with Claude.

highlights.title: scylladb/scylladb
highlights.summary: ScyllaDB is a high‑performance NoSQL data store built with Seastar, compatible with Cassandra and DynamoDB APIs.
highlights.detail: Implemented in C++, the database targets low‑latency workloads and offers drop‑in replacement for existing Cassandra or DynamoDB deployments.

highlights.title: Flowseal/zapret-discord-youtube
highlights.summary: Zapret‑discord‑youtube is a GitHub project linking Zapret functionality with Discord and YouTube platforms.
highlights.detail: Although the repository lacks a description, its name suggests integration tools for managing Zapret‑related content across Discord and YouTube services.

highlights.title: NVlabs/cuda-oxide
highlights.summary: cuda‑oxide is a Rust‑to‑CUDA compiler that emits PTX directly from idiomatic Rust code without DSLs or bindings.
highlights.detail: The tool enables developers to write safe, SIMD‑style GPU kernels in Rust, simplifying GPU programming while preserving Rust’s safety guarantees.

highlights.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec
highlights.summary: turbovec is a Rust‑implemented vector index built on TurboQuant, providing Python bindings for similarity search.
highlights.detail: The library offers high‑performance nearest‑neighbor queries, bridging Rust’s speed with Python’s ease of use for machine‑learning applications.

items.title: Model: Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview
items.summary: Edge0-35B-A3B-preview is a 35‑billion‑parameter text‑generation model on HuggingFace with 1,596 downloads and 601 likes.
items.detail: This preview release targets developers needing large language models for generation tasks and reflects early community interest, as shown by its download and like counts. It is hosted on the HuggingFace model hub.

items.title: 2026 Retrocomputing Challenge: 16-Bit Homebrew Relay Computer
items.summary: The 2026 Retrocomputing Challenge featured a home‑brew 16‑bit relay computer built without transistors.
items.detail: Creator Peter used electromechanical relays to implement a 16‑bit architecture, showcasing extreme retro design for the competition. The project emphasizes hands‑on learning of low‑level hardware.

items.title: Big Infinity Mirror Clock Invites You To Gaze Deeply
items.summary: Andy Huot’s infinity‑mirror digital clock uses RGB LEDs and a stacked diffuser for animated visual effects.
items.detail: The clock combines high‑quality components with clever optics to create a deep‑looking mirror effect, demonstrating creative use of LED animation in a consumer‑grade timepiece.

items.title: Making an Air-Powered Circular Saw with LEGO
items.summary: A functional circular saw powered by compressed air was constructed entirely from LEGO bricks.
items.detail: Jamie’s build shows that LEGO can be used for serious mechanical projects, integrating pneumatic actuation to drive a saw blade for cutting tasks.

items.title: Spin FV-1 Emulator Simplifies Sound Pedal Development
items.summary: The Spin FV‑1 emulator reproduces the FV‑1 DSP chip behavior to aid guitar pedal development.
items.detail: By providing a software model of the popular audio DSP, developers can test and iterate pedal designs without needing physical hardware, speeding prototyping cycles.

items.title: Supercon is Nigh!
items.summary: The 2026 Hackaday Superconference is scheduled for November, marking the event’s tenth annual edition.
items.detail: The conference gathers makers and engineers for talks, workshops, and demos, continuing a decade‑long tradition of community‑driven technology showcases.

items.title: The Heavy Disco-Ball Satellite Designed to Do… Nothing
items.summary: LAGEOS‑1, launched in 1976, is a passive spherical satellite with no electronics, instrumentation, or propulsion.
items.detail: Weighing just under a few hundred kilograms, the satellite serves laser ranging experiments to improve Earth‑gravity models despite its minimalist design.

items.title: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.summary: The GitHub repo Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps lists over 100 free, open‑source AI agents, agent skills, and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.
items.detail: The repository curates links to ready‑to‑use LLM components across chatbots, tool‑use, and data‑retrieval scenarios, organized by function and language. It is community‑maintained and updated regularly, making it a quick reference for engineers building or extending LLM‑based systems. Each entry includes a brief description and a direct link to the source code or demo.
